scope: Two completed960-frame native raw-pipeline arms versus admitted full-search default; repeated regression evidence, not fresh blind validation

raw_initial-comparison.scope: 960 native regression frames: unchanged big2k with deband/TAA disabled, which also disables grain, versus current full-search default. Combined pipeline comparison, not isolated TAA. Same checkpoint and fixed inputs.
raw_initial-comparison.interpretation: Negative LPIPS/DISTS change is better; these measurements supplement visual review and do not establish release admission.

raw_control-comparison.scope: 960 native regression frames: r54 raw-trained SR-only control with deband/TAA and associated grain disabled versus current full-search big2k default. Combined weights/pipeline comparison.
raw_control-comparison.interpretation: Negative LPIPS/DISTS change is better; these measurements supplement visual review and do not establish release admission.

raw_control-vs-raw_initial.scope: 960 native regression frames: raw-trained control versus unchanged big2k under identical raw native pipeline configuration.
raw_control-vs-raw_initial.interpretation: Negative LPIPS/DISTS change is better; these measurements supplement visual review and do not establish release admission.

raw_initial.status: Experimental native evaluation; installed app and shipping default unchanged

visual_review.observations: Six fixed unscaled native crops inspected for both arms. Small local differences; substantial missing structure remains in bee, distant buildings, foliage and water. Raw-trained control improves some natural-scene metrics but introduces large regressions elsewhere. No visually persuasive broad quality breakthrough.

decision: No model or pipeline promotion. Trained raw control is better than unchanged raw model in aggregate but worse than full-search default by6.196%LPIPS/3.643%DISTS. Removing deband/TAA also removes output grain through existing stageDeband gating; combined configuration tested, not isolated TAA. Currentbig2k/full-search default retained.
